description:
Use this when the user wants the picture framed differently in a clip or photo: "zoom in a bit", "mirror
it", "make it 1200 by 628".
Not for: standard shapes 9:16, 1:1, 4:5, 16:9 (style_clip output_shape), light and color (adjust_look) or a
facecam split (edit_clip). Rotation is done in the editor. Undoable (undo_edit). Costs no Horizon Units.
Returns job_id; job_status waits for it.

background.description: Background around the picture: blur, or a color name or hex, e.g. black or #FFCC00. Empty keeps the current one.

blur_amount.description: Strength of the blurred background, 1 to 120. Setting it turns the blur background on.

clip_id.description: Clip or photo id from list_clips (kind photo for photos).

custom_height.description: Custom frame height in pixels, 240 to 4096, e.g. 628. Give it with custom_width.

custom_width.description: Custom frame width in pixels, 240 to 4096, e.g. 1200. Give it with custom_height.

fit.description: fill (picture fills the frame, edges cropped), whole (whole picture, background around it), or a band shape 4:3, 1:1, 16:9 or 9:16. Empty keeps the current fit.

flip_horizontal.description: True mirrors left to right, false turns the mirror off. Leave out to keep it.

flip_vertical.description: True flips upside down, false turns the flip off. Leave out to keep it.

position_x.description: Where the frame sits over the picture, left to right, 0 to 100. 50 is the center, 0 the far left.

position_y.description: Where the frame sits over the picture, top to bottom, 0 to 100. 50 is the center, 0 the top.

zoom.description: Zoom factor, 1 to 4. 1 means no zoom, e.g. 1.3.

name: frame_clip
title: Frame a clip or photo
